ask_threshold_note: NO ask = 1 - best YES bid (size >= 1) of the first Depth10 row in the window; a take requires NO ask >= 0.90, inclusive.
bootstrap_source: breezy.settlement.roi_bound B_RESAMPLES and SEED, imported and checked by the tool
bca_bound: scipy.stats.bootstrap(method=BCa, paired=True, alternative=greater, confidence_level=0.95) on per-day (sum, n) pairs, ratio-of-sums statistic
caveats: Whole-station-day exclusion drops ladders with a dead tail rung (MNAR: missingness depends on the outcome-correlated rung); the exclusions are counted and reported. Netting: the venue represents a NO buy as SELL/BUY_SHORT of YES netted against YES holdings; the scan is execution-blind. Rungs of one station-day are mutually exclusive; weather regimes correlate across stations (handled by day clustering; a per-ladder aggregation is a reported secondary). Depth10 only, never QuoteTick.
cluster_unit: climate_day (whole-day multinomial resample; zero-take days stay in the day vector)
exploratory_days_label: M1's 26 pre-freeze days (D_12Z n=292, -1.4c; D-1 18Z n=330, +0.4c; D_17Z n=204, -0.1c) are EXPLORATORY and never enter the confirmatory sample.
expected_outcome: NO-EDGE or UNDERPOWERED (M1 three-window mean is about -0.3c).
first_forward_day_note: Derived by the tool from git (git show -s --format=%cI <frozen_sha>, converted to UTC, plus one day). A frozen blob cannot contain its own commit date, so this field carries the rule; an ISO date here is refused unless it equals the derived value.

fixed_constants.depth_note: Descriptive screen only; a fixed constant unrelated to any operator cap.

floors_rule: UNDERPOWERED if n_takes < min_takes OR n_days < min_days OR loss_days < min_loss_days; a verdict about power, not a failure.
hit_definition: NO hit = the settled high (FINAL CLI tmax_f) lies OUTSIDE the rung's closed interval [lower, upper] (m1.rung_outcome); net EV per take = hit - (ask + fee + slippage).
holdout_statement: The 2026-07-01 holdout seal applies to model scoring. This screen is market-only and the tape starts 2026-08-30; both facts are disclosed here.
hypothesis: H1: buying NO at the Depth10 ask where the NO ask >= 0.90 (YES bid <= 0.10) has positive mean net EV per take after fee and slippage.
incomplete_day_rule: A station-day is excluded whole if ANY listed rung lacks Depth10 in the window; a climate day is excluded if no station-day survives. Exclusions are counted and reported.
lane: Lane E execution-structure screen under AUT-S r2 with AS-R6: output never enters model-variant evidence and is never read by screen.py. A WINNER nominates only an execution-side admissibility filter on top of a weather-sourced NO decision, never a standalone signal. Not counted in the AUT-S K=48 ledger.
min_loss_days_note: Degeneracy guard only (below it the bootstrap tail is unsupported); it has no power role (M1V3-R17).
one_look: One look only at the read date, no interim verdict. Before the read date the tool emits a counts-only progress report with no verdict field.
power_arithmetic: Per-take SD 0.20 (M1 D_12Z cell: CI half-width 0.0226 -> day-cluster SE 0.0115; 0.0115*sqrt(292)=0.197; Bernoulli cross-check at 5.5% loss rate about 0.22). min_takes = ((1.645+0.842)*0.20/0.02)^2 = 619 -> 620 for a 2c MDE at alpha 0.05 one-sided, 80% power. Rate 11.7 takes/day (292/25) -> ceil(620/11.7)=53 days, plus an 8-day truth lag = 61 days.
prior_disclosure: M1's D_12Z cell CI upper bound is +0.79c before slippage. Under the stacked costs (D_12Z, 1c slippage, conservative fee) a true +2c net edge is already essentially excluded and P(WINNER) is close to zero: this run is a forward confirmation of NO-EDGE on the NO-longshot hypothesis, not discovery.
primary_lower_bound: observed + percentile(centred day-block draws of the ratio-of-sums mean, 5), from m1._bootstrap_stats at alpha=0.05 one-sided; reported p_cell is not Hansen SPA (FQ-R27 by analogy at K=1).
read_offset_note: read_date = first_forward_day + 61 days (53 days of takes + 8-day truth lag).
reference_row: The first Depth10 row with ts_event in [12:00, 13:00) UTC on climate day D (m1._first_row); the tape is scoped by calendar date AND hour; ref_ts must be strictly after the freeze commit time and before settlement.
report_fields: frozen_sha, head_sha, truth CSV sha256, sha256 of the catalog climate-day list, per-day no_bid_side and windows_without_depth, ask-bin composition, per-ladder secondary, depth share (>= 10 contracts), sensitivities.
skipped_observations: Observations without a NO ask (empty YES bid side) and windows without Depth10 are counted per day as denominators; an ask is never synthesised.
sample_note: Fixed sample: forward days first <= d <= first+52 (53 days). A verdict needs as_of >= read_date AND FINAL truth for every tape station-day in the window, or as_of >= first+75 (missing ones are then excluded and counted as no_final_truth); otherwise status PENDING_TRUTH with no verdict. Before the read date the report carries counts only.
statistic: ratio-of-sums mean net EV per take, pooled across stations and rungs
window_note: D_12Z is pre-registered as the first D0 window after the overnight model-cycle repricing. M1 found it the worst of the three cells, so choosing it is adverse selection that biases toward NO-EDGE. D-1_18Z and D_17Z are labelled sensitivities and windows are never summed.
winner_rule: WINNER iff the one-sided 95% lower bound > 0 under BOTH the primary day-block percentile bound and the BCa bound, AND n_takes >= min_takes AND n_days >= min_days AND loss_days >= min_loss_days. A degenerate all-win sample is never WINNER. Otherwise NO-EDGE (floors unmet: UNDERPOWERED).
